```{r load}

P <- readRDS(file.path(RES, "prepared.rds"))
```

**Methods.** All procedures match on the rest score with iterative purification.

* Mantel–Haenszel (`difR::difMH`), ETS Δ\_MH = −2.35 ln α\_MH, ETS A/B/C classes
  (A: p > .05 or |Δ| < 1; C: |Δ| ≥ 1.5 and p ≤ .05; B otherwise).
* Logistic regression (`difR::difLogistic`): omnibus (2 df), uniform and
  non-uniform tests; Nagelkerke ΔR² with Zumbo–Thomas / Jodoin–Gierl classes
  (< .035 negligible, .035–.070 moderate, > .070 large).
* Lord's χ² on separately calibrated 2PL parameters (`difR::difLord`).
* STD P-DIF (Dorans): focal-weighted mean difference in endorsement proportion at
  equal rest score, computed directly. **Its sign fixes the direction of every
  effect independently of package conventions: positive = the focal group endorses
  the item more at the same overall symptom level.**
* Multiplicity: Benjamini–Hochberg within each grouping variable.

Reference group / focal group: Group 1 / Group 2 (gender), younger / older (age),
lower / higher education. Respondents with a missing covariate are excluded from
that covariate's analysis.

```{r dif-function}
std_pdif <- function(X, g) {                  # g: 0 = reference, 1 = focal
  sapply(seq_len(ncol(X)), function(j) {
    rest <- rowSums(X[, -j]); d <- 0; w <- 0
    for (s in unique(rest[g == 1])) {
      f <- g == 1 & rest == s; r <- g == 0 & rest == s
      if (sum(r) == 0) next
      d <- d + sum(f) * (mean(X[f, j]) - mean(X[r, j])); w <- w + sum(f)
    }
    d / w
  })
}

run_dif <- function(X, grp, label, lord = TRUE) {
  keep <- !is.na(grp); X <- as.matrix(X[keep, ]); g <- as.integer(grp[keep]) - 1L
  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s: n_ref = %d, n_focal = %d ===\n", label, sum(g == 0), sum(g == 1)))
  mh  <- difR::difMH(Data = X, group = g, focal.name = 1, purify = TRUE,
                     correct = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "BH")
  lg  <- difR::difLogistic(Data = X, group = g, focal.name = 1, type = "both",
                           criterion = "LRT", purify = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "BH")
  lgu <- difR::difLogistic(Data = X, group = g, focal.name = 1, type = "udif",
                           criterion = "LRT", purify = TRUE)
  lgn <- difR::difLogistic(Data = X, group = g, focal.name = 1, type = "nudif",
                           criterion = "LRT", purify = TRUE)
  ld  <- if (lord) tryCatch(difR::difLord(Data = X, group = g, focal.name = 1, model = "2PL",
                                          purify = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "BH"),
                            error = function(e) { cat("Lord failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL })
         else NULL
  tab <- data.frame(
    item = 1:21, sub = substr(SUBSCALE_OF[ITEMS], 1, 1),
    mh_chi = as.numeric(mh$MH), mh_p = as.numeric(mh$p.value), mh_p_bh = as.numeric(mh$adjusted.p),
    delta_mh = -2.35 * log(as.numeric(mh$alphaMH)),
    std_pdif = std_pdif(X, g),
    lr_chi = as.numeric(lg$Logistik), lr_p = as.numeric(lg$p.value),
    lr_p_bh = as.numeric(lg$adjusted.p), dR2 = as.numeric(lg$deltaR2),
    lr_u = as.numeric(lgu$Logistik), lr_u_p = as.numeric(lgu$p.value),
    lr_nu = as.numeric(lgn$Logistik), lr_nu_p = as.numeric(lgn$p.value),
    lord_chi = if (is.null(ld)) NA else as.numeric(ld$LordChi),
    lord_p   = if (is.null(ld)) NA else as.numeric(ld$p.value),
    lord_p_bh = if (is.null(ld)) NA else as.numeric(ld$adjusted.p))
  tab$lr_nu_p_bh <- p.adjust(tab$lr_nu_p, "BH")
  tab$ets <- with(tab, ifelse(mh_p > .05 | abs(delta_mh) < 1, "A",
                       ifelse(abs(delta_mh) >= 1.5, "C", "B")))
  tab$zumbo <- with(tab, ifelse(dR2 < .035, "A", ifelse(dR2 < .070, "B", "C")))
  print(format(tab, digits = 3))
  cat("\nBH-significant (logistic omnibus):", paste(tab$item[tab$lr_p_bh < .05], collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("BH-significant (Mantel-Haenszel): ", paste(tab$item[tab$mh_p_bh < .05], collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("BH-significant (Lord):            ", paste(tab$item[which(tab$lord_p_bh < .05)], collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Non-uniform DIF, p < .05 unadjusted:", paste(tab$item[tab$lr_nu_p < .05], collapse = ", "),
      "| after BH:", paste(tab$item[tab$lr_nu_p_bh < .05], collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("ETS classes:", paste(names(table(tab$ets)), table(tab$ets), collapse = "  "),
      "| Zumbo classes:", paste(names(table(tab$zumbo)), table(tab$zumbo), collapse = "  "), "\n")
  cat("Direction check: sign(Delta_MH) == sign(STD P-DIF) for all items:",
      all(sign(tab$delta_mh) == sign(tab$std_pdif)), "\n")
  write.csv(tab, file.path(RES, paste0("dif_", label, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  tab
}
```

# 1. Gender, rule A (primary)

```{r gender-A}
dA <- run_dif(P$bin_A, P$gender, "A_gender")
sigA <- dA$item[dA$lr_p_bh < .05]
cat("Direction of flagged items (STD P-DIF > 0 = Group 2 endorses more):\n")
print(dA[dA$item %in% sigA, c("item", "sub", "delta_mh", "std_pdif", "dR2")], digits = 3)
```

# 2. Gender, rule B (sensitivity)

```{r gender-B}
dB <- run_dif(P$bin_B, P$gender, "B_gender")
sigB <- dB$item[dB$lr_p_bh < .05]
cat("\nOverlap of BH-significant sets, rule A and rule B:", paste(intersect(sigA, sigB), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Overlap of ETS-C sets:", paste(intersect(dA$item[dA$ets == "C"], dB$item[dB$ets == "C"]), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 3. Bonus: age and education (exploratory)

Median splits are used for comparability with the gender analysis. Because
dichotomising a continuous covariate discards information, the same
logistic-regression DIF test is repeated in section 4 with age and education
as **continuous** covariates.

```{r age-edu}
dAge <- run_dif(P$bin_A, P$age_grp, "A_age")
dEdu <- run_dif(P$bin_A, P$edu_grp, "A_edu")
```

# 4. Continuous-covariate logistic DIF (robustness for section 3)

Models per item: (1) y ~ rest; (2) + covariate; (3) + covariate × rest.
Uniform DIF = (2) vs (1), non-uniform = (3) vs (2); Nagelkerke ΔR² = (3) vs (1).
The rest score is the raw rest score (no purification), so this is a robustness
check rather than a replacement.

```{r continuous}
nagelkerke <- function(m, m0, n) {
  cs <- 1 - exp(2 * (as.numeric(logLik(m0)) - as.numeric(logLik(m))) / n)
  cs / (1 - exp(2 * as.numeric(logLik(m0)) / n))
}
cont_dif <- function(X, cov, label) {
  keep <- !is.na(cov); X <- as.matrix(X[keep, ]); z <- as.numeric(scale(cov[keep]))
  n <- nrow(X)
  out <- t(sapply(seq_len(ncol(X)), function(j) {
    y <- X[, j]; rest <- as.numeric(scale(rowSums(X[, -j])))
    m0 <- glm(y ~ 1, binomial); m1 <- glm(y ~ rest, binomial)
    m2 <- glm(y ~ rest + z, binomial); m3 <- glm(y ~ rest * z, binomial)
    c(beta_cov = unname(coef(m2)["z"]),
      lr_u = 2 * (logLik(m2) - logLik(m1)), lr_nu = 2 * (logLik(m3) - logLik(m2)),
      dR2 = nagelkerke(m3, m0, n) - nagelkerke(m1, m0, n))
  }))
  out <- data.frame(item = 1:21, out)
  out$p_u  <- pchisq(out$lr_u, 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
  out$p_nu <- pchisq(out$lr_nu, 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
  out$p_total_bh <- p.adjust(pchisq(out$lr_u + out$lr_nu, 2, lower.tail = FALSE), "BH")
  cat("\n===", label, "(continuous, n =", n, ") ===\n"); print(format(out, digits = 3))
  cat("BH-significant:", paste(out$item[out$p_total_bh < .05], collapse = ", "),
      "| max dR2 =", round(max(out$dR2), 4), "(item", out$item[which.max(out$dR2)], ")\n")
  write.csv(out, file.path(RES, paste0("dif_continuous_", label, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  out
}
cAge <- cont_dif(P$bin_A, P$dat$Age, "age")
cEdu <- cont_dif(P$bin_A, P$dat$Education_Years, "education")
cat("\nAge items flagged by both the median split and the continuous test:",
    paste(intersect(dAge$item[dAge$lr_p_bh < .05], cAge$item[cAge$p_total_bh < .05]), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 5. Numbers for the essay and save

```{r numbers}
for (cls in c("A", "B", "C")) num(paste0("ETS", cls), sum(dA$ets == cls))
num("DIFSig", paste(sigA, collapse = ", ")); num("DIFNSig", length(sigA))
num("MaxDeltaMH", f2(max(abs(dA$delta_mh)))); num("MaxDeltaMHItem", dA$item[which.max(abs(dA$delta_mh))])
num("MaxdRtwo", dec(max(dA$dR2), 3)); num("MaxdRtwoItem", dA$item[which.max(dA$dR2)])
num("DIFSigB", paste(sigB, collapse = ", ")); num("DIFNSigB", length(sigB))
num("DIFOverlapAB", paste(intersect(sigA, sigB), collapse = ", "))
num("ETSCB", paste(dB$item[dB$ets == "C"], collapse = ", ")); num("ETSCNB", sum(dB$ets == "C"))
num("DIFNonUnifItems", paste(dA$item[dA$lr_nu_p < .05], collapse = " and "))
num("DIFAgeN", sum(dAge$lr_p_bh < .05)); num("DIFAgeMaxdR", dec(max(dAge$dR2), 3))
num("DIFAgeETSC", paste(dAge$item[dAge$ets == "C"], collapse = ", "))
num("DIFEduN", sum(dEdu$lr_p_bh < .05)); num("DIFEduMaxdR", dec(max(dEdu$dR2), 3))
num("DIFAgeContN", sum(cAge$p_total_bh < .05)); num("DIFEduContN", sum(cEdu$p_total_bh < .05))
saveRDS(list(gender_A = dA, gender_B = dB, age = dAge, edu = dEdu,
             age_cont = cAge, edu_cont = cEdu), file.path(RES, "dif.rds"))
log_close()
```
